_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 78.4% analog match is compelling but the coil's 5% directional break rate over 12h windows and the analyst's 19.6% direction accuracy make HOLD the statistically honest call — a directional UP claim requires seeing the ETF>DXY breaker fire first.
next_move.brains_agree: Split: analyst explicitly calls HOLD with medium conviction citing coil statistics; narrative implies accumulation-driven upside but does not issue an explicit directional forward call — consensus defaults to the analyst's graded HOLD.
next_move.confirmed_if: etf_flows sustain >90 AND btc_momentum_30d pushes >60 with DXY breaking below 100
next_move.invalidated_if: fear_greed drops below 20 OR funding spikes >70 OR mvrv_zscore collapses below 15
